messages.text:
Hello! 

 

 
I just received the neck warmer yesterday. It looks and feels beautiful. 

 

 
I noticed that the back edge is starting to fray. Is the normal and ok ? I just don't want it to continue up the entire garment. 

 

 
Thanks, 

 
Allison

messages.text:

 We apologize for the longer than usual response time. We are currently receiving a higher number of inquiries than usual, but we are doing everything we can to process them quickly.

 Looking forward to helping you,
 

 Warmly,

messages.subject: Re: neck warmer
messages.text:
Hello Allison,
 

 We are sorry to hear that.
 

 To rectify this, we would like to proceed with a return/exchange in order to send you a new neck warmer.
 

 Here are the steps to follow for a return/exchange: 
 

 1. Go to https://lasclay.happyreturns.com/ to obtain a return label. After entering your order number and zip code, select the products to return and then choose the replacement items. At the end, you will receive a prepaid return label.
 

 2. Print the label, pack the items to be returned, and affix the label on the package. Please use envelopes/bags instead of boxes, as they are more expensive.
 

 3. Drop off at a red Canada Post box or the nearest post office.
 

 4. Once we receive the return, we will send the new product(s). 😊
 

 Warmly,
 __
 Hari 
 

 Lasclay
